sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It's a Tuesday afternoon. You're standing in aisle four of a neighborhood convenience store, comparing two cans of soup, when your phone suddenly vibrates.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You glance at the screen.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: An emergency alert.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Not a weather warning. Not a missing-person notification.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A national emergency broadcast.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: "BIOLOGICAL EMERGENCY. A neurological outbreak has been confirmed. Avoid all contact with infected individuals. Seek immediate shelter. Secure all doors and windows."

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You read it again.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then someone screams outside.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You turn toward the front windows.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A man has abandoned his car in the middle of the road. He's running toward the intersection, looking over his shoulder.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Behind him, three people are chasing him.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: At first, you think it's an accident. Maybe a fight. Maybe something you don't want to get involved in.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then the man falls.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The three people reach him.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: And they don't help him.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Within seconds, the street becomes unrecognizable.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Cars collide at the intersection. Drivers abandon their vehicles. People run between buildings, knocking over anything in their way.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You step backward.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The store entrance is only a few meters away.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You rush toward it, grab the heavy metal deadbolt, and lock both doors.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A moment later, someone slams against the glass.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It's a delivery driver.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You've seen him here dozens of times.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He's shouting something, but you can't understand him.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You move closer.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then you notice another person approaching behind him.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The delivery driver turns around.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: His expression changes.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He starts running again.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: But this time, he's running away from the store.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You step back and pull the security shutters down as far as they will go.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: For now, you're inside.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: And outside, the world is falling apart.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The first ten minutes pass quickly.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You check your phone. No useful information.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You try calling someone. The call doesn't connect.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You look through the windows again.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: There are fewer people running now.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: That's almost worse.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You walk toward the checkout counter and look around the store.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Four aisles.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Two refrigerators.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A small office.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: One storage room.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It isn't much, but it has walls, a roof, and a lock.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You tell yourself that should be enough.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then you start checking the supplies.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Aisle one is almost empty. Someone has already taken most of the snacks.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Aisle two has a few dented cans, some pickled vegetables, and a bag of rice with a torn corner.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The refrigerators are still running, but the power keeps flickering.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You open the office and check the inventory computer.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The numbers don't make sense.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: According to the system, the store should have received two deliveries this week.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Neither arrived.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The actual stock is less than half the recorded amount.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You check the shelves again.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Four liters of bottled water.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Three protein bars.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Half a jar of peanut butter.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Two bruised apples.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: And a handful of canned food.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You sit down.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: If you ration everything carefully, you might manage for a few days.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: But that's assuming the water stays clean, the refrigerators keep working, and nothing gets inside.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You look toward the front entrance.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Something is standing outside.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A woman.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: She's facing the glass, completely motionless.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You watch her for several seconds.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then she slowly raises her hand and presses it against the window.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Her mouth moves.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You can't hear anything through the glass.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: But you can read her lips.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: "Help me."

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You don't move.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Because behind her, another figure has just appeared.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: And it isn't walking normally.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The sun disappears behind the buildings.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The store's automatic lights switch on, illuminating the empty aisles.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You decide to barricade the entrance.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You drag two metal shelves toward the front doors and stack crates behind them.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It's exhausting work, but eventually the entrance is blocked.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then you remember something.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The delivery entrance.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You haven't checked it.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You walk toward the storage room with a flashlight.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The back door has an old wooden frame, a rusted padlock, and a small wire-mesh window.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It looks considerably weaker than the front entrance.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You push a heavy hand truck against it and secure the handle with a cargo strap attached to a steel support beam.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It's not a perfect solution.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: But it's something.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You return to the checkout counter.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: For the next hour, nothing happens.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You almost begin to relax.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then you hear a metallic noise.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Clatter.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It comes from the storage room.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You switch off your flashlight.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Another noise.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: This time, something drags across the floor.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You move toward the back corridor.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The emergency lights flicker overhead.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You reach the doorway and look inside.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The wire-mesh window has been broken.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Glass covers the concrete floor.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: And something is pushing an arm through the opening.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You step backward.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The hand is moving.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Its fingers repeatedly open and close, searching for something to grab.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then you hear another sound.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A low clicking noise.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Something is trying to squeeze through the broken window.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You look at the cargo strap.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It's already stretched tight.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You grab the hand truck and push its metal base against the door.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The creature forces its arm farther through the opening.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You lean against the hand truck.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: For several seconds, you manage to hold it.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then another impact comes from outside.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Something else has reached the door.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You look toward the narrow corridor.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: There are now multiple shapes moving behind the broken window.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You abandon the storage room and run back toward the main floor.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Your barricade is no longer a temporary inconvenience.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It's the only thing keeping you alive.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You spend the next hour sitting behind the checkout counter.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Your hands are shaking.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You check your supplies again.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Three protein bars.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Four liters of water.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Half a jar of peanut butter.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You calculate the amount you can afford to consume.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then you look at the store's clock.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It's almost midnight.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You've been inside for hours, and you still have no idea whether the emergency services are operating.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You try the radio behind the counter.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Static.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You switch frequencies.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Nothing.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Finally, you take out your phone and open the offline city map.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The nearest major building is a municipal transit station, two blocks away.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You zoom in.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: There's an underground maintenance entrance on the eastern side.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The station has reinforced concrete walls, emergency generators, and access corridors connected to the old storm drainage network.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It might be a better shelter.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: But getting there means crossing the street.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: And you have no idea what's waiting outside.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You put the phone away.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then you hear something from the front entrance.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Not scratching.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Not banging.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A phone ringing.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You look through a gap in the shelves.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: There's a person standing outside.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Holding a mobile phone.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The sound is coming from their pocket.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: They don't seem to notice it.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: They simply stand there, staring at the store.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then another infected approaches.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It stops beside the first one.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: And both turn toward the glass.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You slowly move away.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The store isn't just surrounded anymore.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It's attracting attention.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: By morning, you have made your decision.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You're leaving.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You pack the remaining food into a small backpack.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Four bottles of water.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The protein bars.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The peanut butter.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A first-aid kit.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A flashlight.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You also take a jacket and a spare phone charger.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You check the front barricade.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Still standing.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then you check the rear door.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The cargo strap is hanging loose.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The hand truck has fallen onto its side.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Something has already entered the storage room.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You don't wait to find out what.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You return to the front entrance.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Move the shelves.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Remove the crates.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Unlock the deadbolt.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Before opening the door, you stop.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The street is completely silent.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: No engines.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: No sirens.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: No shouting.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You look through the glass.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: An abandoned bus blocks most of the road.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A traffic light continues changing colors over an empty intersection.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: And several infected figures are standing near the bus.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: They're not moving.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: They're just facing the same direction.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Toward the underground station.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You step away from the window.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Something is happening down there.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: But staying here is no longer an option.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You open the door.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Cold air enters the store.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You step outside and carefully close it behind you.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The first few meters are easy.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You move between abandoned vehicles, avoiding broken glass and anything that might make noise.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Halfway down the street, you notice a child's backpack lying beside a bicycle.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You stop.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: There's a small photograph attached to it.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A family.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Two parents and a little boy.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You look around.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Nothing.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You continue toward the station.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then you hear footsteps behind you.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You turn.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: An infected man is standing beside the convenience store entrance.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He recognizes movement.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: His head turns.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You start walking faster.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then another figure emerges from between two cars.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You break into a run.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The station entrance is visible now.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Twenty meters.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Fifteen.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Ten.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You reach the stairs and descend as quickly as possible.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: At the bottom, a metal security shutter blocks the entrance.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You pull it.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Nothing.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Locked.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You look around for another way in.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then you notice a card reader beside a narrow maintenance door.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You remember the municipal station map.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: There should be an emergency access point nearby.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You search the backpack for something useful.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Nothing.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then a voice comes from behind the door.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: "Are you alone?"

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You freeze.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You look back toward the stairs.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The infected are approaching.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You have seconds to decide whether to trust whoever is on the other side.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You answer.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: "No."

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The lock clicks.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The door opens.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: And someone pulls you inside.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The room is small.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A desk.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Two chairs.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: An emergency radio.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A wall covered with evacuation maps.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A man stands near the entrance, holding a flashlight.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He looks at your backpack.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then at your face.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: "How many followed you?"

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You don't answer immediately.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You ask where you are.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He tells you it's a municipal maintenance control room.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The station has been closed since the outbreak began.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You look at the maps.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Several underground stations are marked with red circles.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Some have handwritten notes beside them.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: "EVACUATED."

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: "SEALED."

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: "NO ACCESS."

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: One station has a different marking.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Yours.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You ask him what happened here.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He looks at the radio.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then at the map.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: "People came down here yesterday. We locked the doors to keep the infected outside."

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You ask how many people survived.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He doesn't answer.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Instead, he points toward a second door.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Beyond it is a narrow maintenance corridor.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: At the far end, you can see a dim green emergency light.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He tells you the underground network connects to an older storm drainage tunnel.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: If the main station becomes compromised, there's another way out.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You finally begin to relax.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then the radio turns on.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Static fills the room.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A voice comes through.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: "Control room, do you copy?"

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The man reaches for the radio.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Before he can respond, another voice interrupts.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A child.

sentences.speaker: child
sentences.text: "Please don't open the door."

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You look toward the maintenance corridor.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The man slowly lowers his hand.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You ask him what that was.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He doesn't respond.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then you hear three knocks.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: From the other side of the second door.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The man looks at you.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: And says something you weren't prepared to hear.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: "Whatever you do, don't answer it."

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You look back at the radio.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The child's voice returns.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: This time, it's much closer.

sentences.speaker: child
sentences.text: "Dad?"

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You turn toward the man.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: His face has gone completely pale.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Because the voice on the radio belongs to his son.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: And his son is standing right beside you.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You slowly look down.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The boy who came with you from the street is still holding your jacket.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He hasn't spoken once since entering the room.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Now he looks up at you.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: And whispers:

sentences.speaker: child
sentences.text: "That's not my dad."

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The emergency lights go out.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: And somewhere inside the maintenance corridor...

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Something begins running toward you.
